mountain valleys tonight and Tuesday morning. Visibility will be
restricted with any fog and could be as low as half a mile or less

and other elevated surfaces.

encountering any slick surfaces and areas of low visibility.

near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in
such conditions, stay off the rocks.
